arguments.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS total_amount_usd, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000
arguments.explanation: Sums the amount in dollars of all transactions on cards whose credit limit is above $20,000, and gives the transaction count alongside it.
assumptions: 'Above $20,000' is a credit limit strictly greater than 2,000,000 cents.
All transactions are included, whether labelled or not, since the question names no fraud filter.
Negative amounts (56,900 rows in the data) are included as recorded in the sum; they are not treated as refunds or excluded.
The full period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is covered, since no date range was given.
